answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 545 Country: India Title: Is TV repairing as a profession Halal in Islam? Also how about repairing Computer Monitors? Question: Is TV repairing as a profession HALAL in Islam? Also how about repairing Computer Monitors? Answer ID: 545 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 544/J) The profession of TV repairing is not good. One should avoid it. As far as the matter of repairing computer monitors, it is allowed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
